verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a self-hosted AI assistant gateway, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions telemetry, usage tracking, analytics, or any opt-out setting. Self-hosting, local storage and sandboxing are adjacent privacy traits, not a documented telemetry opt-out control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
